body: Feature integration contract for publication: use an actual accepted collectSprintLearningEvidence snapshot in the positive publication fixture. Its item identity is sourceId + sourcePath with contentHash over exact preserved item.content; do not invent a different whole-SQL-row hash projection that the generated-card worker cannot produce. If evidence references need a bounded path/item selector, evolve the shared contract without altering older absent fields/hashes. The eventual generated card owns its immutable source snapshot; submission/publication must validate against that bound snapshot/source run/sprint/card rather than a later mutable read model. Keep this a small production service using existing fixtures, not new test/probe infrastructure. DM-721 owns list/get/retire/replace and indexed management history; publication must reuse its final persistence/view conventions after acceptance. Empty proposed learning lists are legitimate.
